# PhotoFrame — Azure container deployment

<!-- Generated by Auto (Composer) - 2026-05-30 -->

Deploy PhotoFrame as a **Linux container on Azure Container Instances (ACI)**, using images from **GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io)** — same model as BookForge.

Storage for Google photo JPEGs is selected at **container launch** via environment variables (backed by [storage-lib](https://github.com/ArnaudBuisine/storage-lib)): **Azure Blob** (recommended in Azure) or **filesystem** under `/app/data`.

---

## Prerequisites

| Item | Notes |
|------|--------|
| Azure subscription | Contributor on resource group |
| GitHub repo | [PhotoFrame](https://github.com/ArnaudBuisine/PhotoFrame) with Actions enabled |
| [storage-lib](https://github.com/ArnaudBuisine/storage-lib) | Built automatically in CI when building the image |
| Azure Storage account | Required when `PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_PROVIDER=azure` |
| Google Photos OAuth | Client ID, secret, refresh token (Picker scope) |

---

## 1. One-time Azure setup

```bash
az login
az group create --name PhotoFrame --location southeastasia
```

Create a **Storage account** (if using Azure Blob for the image cache):

```bash
az storage account create -g PhotoFrame -n YOURUNIQUESTORAGE -l southeastasia --sku Standard_LRS
az storage container create --account-name YOURUNIQUESTORAGE --name photoframe
# Connection string (portal or CLI):
az storage account show-connection-string -g PhotoFrame -n YOURUNIQUESTORAGE -o tsv
```

Create a **service principal** for GitHub Actions:

```bash
az ad sp create-for-rbac --name "photoframe-github-actions" \
  --role contributor \
  --scopes /subscriptions/YOUR_SUBSCRIPTION_ID/resourceGroups/PhotoFrame \
  --sdk-auth
```

Copy the JSON output into GitHub secret **`AZURE_CREDENTIALS`**.

---

## 2. GitHub secrets

In the PhotoFrame repository: **Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions**.

| Secret | Required | Purpose |
|--------|----------|---------|
| `AZURE_CREDENTIALS` | Yes | Azure login JSON from `az ad sp create-for-rbac` |
| `AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING` | If storage=azure | Blob storage for cached JPEGs |
| `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_CLIENT_ID` | Yes (google source) | OAuth client ID |
| `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_CLIENT_SECRET` | Yes | OAuth client secret (secure in ACI) |
| `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_REFRESH_TOKEN` | Yes | OAuth refresh token (secure in ACI) |

`GITHUB_TOKEN` is used automatically to pull from ghcr.io when creating the container.

Optional: create a GitHub **Environment** named `production` and attach the same secrets for approval gates.

---

## 3. Build and push the image (from GitHub)

1. Open **Actions → Build PhotoFrame container**.
2. Click **Run workflow** (or push to `main` — workflow runs on changes to backend/frontend/Dockerfile).
3. Image is pushed to:

   `ghcr.io/<your-github-user>/photoframe:main`

4. In **Packages**, set the package visibility to **Public** *or* ensure the deploy workflow’s registry login can read it (deploy uses `GITHUB_TOKEN`).

**First-time local build** (optional):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ArnaudBuisine/PhotoFrame.git
git clone https://github.com/ArnaudBuisine/storage-lib.git
# storage-lib must sit next to PhotoFrame:
#   parent/
#     PhotoFrame/
#     storage-lib/
cd PhotoFrame
docker build -t photoframe:local .
```

---

## 4. Deploy to Azure (from GitHub)

1. **Actions → Deploy PhotoFrame to Azure Container Instances**.
2. **Run workflow**:
   - **storage_provider**: `azure` (Blob) or `filesystem` (`/app/data`, ephemeral on ACI)
   - **image_tag**: `main` (must exist in ghcr.io)
   - **environment**: `production`
3. When finished, the job prints URLs, for example:

   - Slideshow: `http://photoframe.southeastasia.azurecontainer.io:8082/`
   - Picker: `http://photoframe.southeastasia.azurecontainer.io:8082/myphotoframe`

---

## 5. Environment variables at container launch

These are the variables set by the deploy workflow (you can mirror them in `azure-configurations.template.txt` for manual `az container create`).

### Application

| Variable | Example | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `PHOTOFRAME_HOME` | `/app` | Base directory for config and data files |
| `SERVER_PORT` | `8082` | HTTP port (expose on ACI) |
| `LOGGING_FILE_NAME` | `/app/logs/photoframe.log` | Main log file |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | Root log level for `com.mwa.photoframe` |
| `photoframe.source` | `google` | Image source |

### Storage (storage-lib)

| Variable | Example | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_PROVIDER` | `azure` | `filesystem` or `azure` |
| `PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_ROOT` | `/app/data` | Filesystem root when provider=filesystem |
| `AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING` | *(secure)* | Azure Blob connection string when provider=azure |
| `PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_AZURE_CONTAINER` | `photoframe` | Blob container name |
| `PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_GOOGLE_PREFIX` | `google-photos-cache` | Key prefix for cached JPEGs |

Spring Boot also accepts `STORAGE_PROVIDER`, `STORAGE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING`, etc. (relaxed binding); PhotoFrame defaults to the `PHOTOFRAME_*` names above.

### Google Photos

| Variable | Secure? | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_CLIENT_ID` | No | OAuth client ID |
| `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_CLIENT_SECRET` | Yes | OAuth secret |
| `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_REFRESH_TOKEN` | Yes | Refresh token |
| `PHOTOFRAME_GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS` | — | Path written by entrypoint (`/app/google-photos-credentials.properties`) |
| `PHOTOFRAME_GOOGLE_PICKED_FILE` | — | `/app/google-photos-picked.json` |
| `PHOTOFRAME_DISPLAY_SETTINGS` | — | `/app/slideshow-display.json` |

Credentials can be supplied either as the three `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_*` variables (recommended in Azure) or as a mounted properties file.

---

## 6. Manual deploy (`az` CLI)

Copy `azure-configurations.template.txt` to `azure-configurations.txt`, fill in values, and run the `az container create` block for your storage choice.

Delete/recreate:

```bash
az container delete -g PhotoFrame -n photoframe --yes
```

Logs:

```bash
az container logs -g PhotoFrame -n photoframe
```

---

## 7. Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Check |
|---------|--------|
| Image pull failed | Package public on ghcr.io or valid `GITHUB_TOKEN` / PAT with `read:packages` |
| Storage errors | `PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_PROVIDER` and `AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING` when using azure |
| Google auth errors | Secrets `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_*`; enable Picker API and correct scope |
| 404 on slideshow | Pick photos at `/myphotoframe`; `google-photos-picked.json` is empty until you import |
| Health check failed in workflow | Wait longer; `az container logs`; port **8082** must be in `--ports` |
